title: Better Than Blue Slimes!
description: A BTA! Blue slimes texture pack!
body:
Better than Blue Slimes! is made to retexture slimes and sticky pistons to be blue instead of green!

This is specifically made for Better than Adventure! If you'd like to learn more about it you can visit their [Discord!](https://discord.com/invite/jvwD8BKq5e)
